entity: Louisiana's five-year re-inspection rate of hazardous-waste manufacturing plants (large quantity generators), vs other states
why: The EPA OIG table gives Louisiana 59% LQG inspection coverage over a 165-facility universe, with Illinois 48% and Connecticut 36% below it, ranking Louisiana neither last nor at 49.5%. Its universe (all LQGs, not manufacturing-only) and coverage definition differ from ours, so the numbers and the ranking can't be lined up; nothing else matches.
